title: "Is there an AI bubble?” Gavin Baker and David George
summary:

thesis: The speakers argue that an AI bubble does not exist today because the massive infrastructure spending is backed by significant free cash flow and cash reserves from major technology companies. They contrast this with the 2000 telecom bubble, noting that unlike the era of 'dark fiber' where infrastructure was built without usage, current AI spending is already generating positive returns on investment and driving a 150x increase in token processing.
